markup:
The amount of backup storage you need depends on **how much data you have, how often it changes, and how long you want to retain backups**.

A good starting point is **2–3 times the size of the data you're backing up**.

| Data to back up | Recommended backup storage |
|---|---|
| 100 GB | 200–300 GB |
| 500 GB | 1–1.5 TB |
| 1 TB | 2–3 TB |
| 2 TB | 4–6 TB |
| 5 TB | 10–15 TB |
| 10 TB | 20–30 TB |

These are rough estimates for personal backups with some version history. Long-term retention or frequent changes can require much more.

## Calculate your backup storage

{@body const [data,setData] = DIL.useState("1000")}
{@body const [copies,setCopies] = DIL.useState("3")}
{@body const [change,setChange] = DIL.useState("1")}
{@body const [days,setDays] = DIL.useState("30")}
{@body const total = (Number(data)*Number(copies)+Number(data)*Number(change)/100*Number(days))/1000}
<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  <box gap={1}>
    <label>Amount of data to back up</label>
    <radio-group direction="col" value={data} onChange={setData}>
      <radio value="100">100 GB</radio>
      <radio value="500">500 GB</radio>
      <radio value="1000">1 TB</radio>
      <radio value="2000">2 TB</radio>
      <radio value="5000">5 TB</radio>
    </radio-group>
  </box>
  <divider color="subtle"/>
  <box gap={1}>
    <label>Number of full backup copies</label>
    <radio-group value={copies} onChange={setCopies}>
      <radio value="1">1</radio>
      <radio value="2">2</radio>
      <radio value="3">3</radio>
    </radio-group>
  </box>
  <box gap={1}>
    <row align="center" justify="between">
      <label>Daily data change</label>
      **{change}%**
    </row>
    <slider min={0} max={10} step={0.5} value={Number(change)} onChange={v=>setChange(String(v))}/>
  </box>
  <box gap={1}>
    <label>Incremental backup retention</label>
    <radio-group value={days} onChange={setDays}>
      <radio value="7">7 days</radio>
      <radio value="30">30 days</radio>
      <radio value="90">90 days</radio>
    </radio-group>
  </box>
  <box background="surface-secondary" radius="lg" padding={3} gap={1}>
    <text color="secondary" weight="medium" size="xs">Estimated backup storage</text>
    <title size="2xl" color="default" tabularNums>{total.toFixed(2)} TB</title>
    <text color="secondary" size="xs">Simplified estimate, before compression, deduplication, and free-space headroom.</text>
  </box>
</box>

**One question:** Are you backing up a personal computer, a NAS, a server, or a database?

The recommendation can vary significantly depending on which one you're using.
